(Japanese: '''タイチ''' ''Taichi'') is a character in [[Pocket Monsters XY: The Legend of the Pokémon Dragon King]]. He is a competitor in the [[Dragon King Cup]], where he meets and becomes friends with {{OBP|Akira|LDK}}. He possesses a [[Mega Ring]] and an [[Ampharosite]], which gives his {{p|Ampharos}} the capability to [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolve]] into Mega Ampharos.

==History==
Taichi and {{OBP|Akira|LDK}} first meet in ''[[LDK3|Dragon King Cup Finally Begins!!]]'' at the Dragon King Cup. They later face each other in battle in ''[[LDK4|Fierce Fighting! Akira VS Taichi!!]]'', which ended with Akira's Mega Charizard defeating Taichi's Mega Ampharos.
